title: flt.fbank5x1~
description: `flt.fbank5x1~` is a five-band, one-octave Butterworth filter bank for splitting an input signal into parallel low-pass (250 Hz), band-pass (500, 1000, and 2000 Hz), and high-pass (4000 Hz) bands. Its five band gains can be set in dB using a five-element list or the corresponding frequency properties, and `reset` clears the filter state.
